name: (+/-)-ADB-CHMINACA
summary: ADB-CHMINACA (also known as ADMB-CHMINACA and MAB-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid.289 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication. It was identified in cannabinoid blends in Japan in early 2015.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity of Ki = 0.289 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.

uses.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity of Ki = 0.289 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its CHM tail is a cyclohexylmethyl group, a ring rather than a straight chain. It was first found in cannabinoid blends in Japan in early 2015.
fact.zh: 它的「CHM」尾端是環己基甲基，也就是一個環而不是直鏈。它於2015年初在日本的大麻素混合草料中首次被發現。
fact.zhHans: 它的「CHM」尾端是环己基甲基，也就是一个环而不是直链。它于2015年初在日本的大麻素混合草料中首次被发现。
